email_subject: Update on Your Billing Issue – Refund Initiated
email_body:
Dear Ananya Sharma,

Thank you for contacting us regarding your recent billing issue. We understand that you were charged INR 2,499 for your monthly subscription, despite having downgraded your plan to INR 1,499 before the billing date. We also appreciate the screenshot of the invoice that you provided, which helped us address your concern promptly.

Our billing team has thoroughly reviewed your account and confirmed that the higher charge was made in error. We have initiated a refund of INR 1,000 to your original payment method. Please allow 5-7 business days for the amount to be credited to your account. No further follow-up is required from your end at this time.

If you have any other questions or need further assistance, please feel free to reach out to us.

Best regards,
Service Team

email_subject: Update on Your Product Delivery Complaint – Logistics Investigation in Progress
email_body:
Dear Mr. Mehta,

Thank you for reaching out to us regarding the delayed delivery of your order, which was scheduled to arrive on 10 August. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this delay has caused.

We have received your order details and the screenshot of the tracking page showing the status as "In Transit" for the past four days. To resolve this matter, our customer support team has contacted the logistics team and initiated a delivery investigation request. 

Currently, the case is under investigation by the logistics team due to the package exceeding the expected delivery date. You can expect an update from us within the next 48 hours.

We appreciate your patience and understanding. We will keep you informed as soon as we receive new information from the logistics team. If you have any further questions or concerns, please feel free to reply to this email or contact us at any time.

Best regards,
Service Team

email_body:
